payload.reason: The evidence describes methods for extracting textual patterns used in automated error generation (AEG) from annotated corpora, focusing on incorrect and correct phrase pairs.

claims.text: Textual patterns are extracted in the form of (incorrect phrase, correct phrase) from an annotated corpus.
Patterns are learned for generating all types of errors by analyzing changes in word forms and using part-of-speech tags for matching.
The extraction process includes identifying short transformation patterns with context tokens on both sides of the affected phrase.
